user.title: Heating curve: basics

data_description.outdoor_sensor: Required. Your own weather station or any outdoor sensor.
data_description.outdoor_fallback_sensor: Optional. Used while the main sensor is unavailable, e.g. the heat pump's outdoor sensor.
data_description.room_sensors: Optional. Averaged. Without room temperature there is no room correction, no I-term and no comfort limit for the cycling lock.
data_description.target_entity: Optional. Without it the integration creates its own target temperature number.

user.description: Only the outdoor temperature is required. Every other source is optional; without it the matching part of the formula is left out.

data_description.weather_entities: Optional. Need an hourly forecast; the first one that delivers is used.
data_description.solcast_today: Optional. Solcast sensor with the detailedForecast attribute.
data_description.solcast_tomorrow: Optional. Needed for horizons past midnight.

data.mode_dhw_value: Operating mode value for hot water

data_description.absolute_min_flow: Plant limit; the min/max flow numbers can only move inside these limits.
data_description.compressor_sensor: Optional. Enables the cycling lock and the runtime/start figures.
data_description.mode_entity: Optional. Hot water runs are not counted as starts.
data_description.heat_meter_sensor: Optional. For heat per day and kWh per heating degree day.
data_description.comparison_sensor: Optional. Another flow sensor to compare with, e.g. your previous heating curve.

error.flow_limits: The minimum flow must be below the maximum flow.
